req.title: Basic-auth requires both segments
req.statement: The system shall route /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> only when both user and passwd segments are provided.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must only route when BOTH path segments are present. Tests cover: (1) positive path with valid credentials matching both segments, (2) negative path with wrong credentials, (3) negative path with missing one segment (boundary: only user provided), (4) boundary with empty-string-like segments via URL encoding, (5) decision table covering all combinations of correct/incorrect user and passwd, (6) negative path with no Authorization header at all. Each test asserts exact status codes and JSON payload fields to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Both user and passwd path segments are provided
Authorization header matches the path segments exactly
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypass with correct Basic Auth header
Assert JSON body has authenticated==True and user=='myuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-049: both segments provided, credentials match -> 200 + authenticated payload
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass',
               headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
assert 'authenticated' in data
assert 'user' in data
assert len(data) == 2

def test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_authenticated_true():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass',
                   headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
    assert len(data) == 2

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_user_field_in_response
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Both segments provided with distinct values
Authorization header matches exactly
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with matching Basic Auth
Assert user field equals 'alice' (not 'passwd', not empty)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-049: response user field must reflect the <user> path segment, not <passwd>
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_correct_user_field_in_response():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/alice/secret',
                   headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'alice'
    assert data['user'] != 'secret'
    assert data['user'] != 'passwd'
